generate_equation_and_solution: generate a modular arithmetic equation with brackets and its solution given modulus and length
generate_raw_dataset: generate a dataset of modular arithmetic equations and their solutions encoded as integer arrays
create_SolveEquation_task: create a SolveEquation generalization task instance with a specified modulus for training
sample_batch_SolveEquation: sample a batch of one-hot encoded equations and solutions from a SolveEquation task
get_SolveEquation_sizes: get the input and output sizes of a SolveEquation task based on its modulus
